summary: Backend (30 pytest, 30/30 pass) and frontend smoke tests for the new BudgetBakers-style category hierarchy (11 parents + 82 subs = 93). All hierarchy/parent_category_id/analytics rollup APIs work. Frontend: TS+Zustand build loads, PeriodSwitcher month grid + Quick jump presets render, AddRecord modal renders all 10 expense parent tiles with data-testid parent-pick-<name>, Food & Drinks parent reveals 4 sub tiles + Back button. Income tab restricts to 1 parent (Income) with 12 subs. Saving an expense to a Food & Drinks sub persists and shows up across Dashboard balance (-77), Cash Flow (-77), Spending donut (Food & Drinks 77), Records list (1 record), and Analytics > Incomes & Expenses tab where Food & Drinks parent row expands to show the child subcategory row with the same -77 amount.

ui_bugs.component: Recharts containers in inactive Analytics tabs
ui_bugs.issue: Console warning 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' (also flagged in iter1).

Not strictly validated in this run (test selector targeted wrong combobox index; combobox order is Sort/Account/Category/Type). Backend filter parent_category_id is verified working via pytest, and AddRecord parent picker uses parents-only, so highly likely correct. Recommend adding data-testid (e.g. 'records-category-filter') on this select for deterministic testing.

action_items: Add data-testid='records-category-filter' (and similar deterministic testids on account/type/sort selects) on Records page sidebar selects so e2e tests can target them reliably.
Suppress Recharts width(-1) warnings by lazy-mounting charts inside inactive tab panels (pre-existing from iter1).
Optional: cleanup leftover 'fed' account created in iter1 frontend run if you want a clean demo seed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_records: when both `search` and `account_id` are present, the code appends to q['$or'] but $or with account_id+search may match unintended records (account OR search-note). Consider $and wrapping to keep semantics 'account AND (note|payee match)'.

server.py: seed_defaults wipes & re-seeds categories whenever either parents or subs are missing — this will also delete any user-created custom categories on restart. For a multi-user/production model this is risky; guard with `is_default: True` filter when wiping, or version the seed.
server.py Record.date is `str` with no ISO validation — bad client input could break analytics string range comparisons. Use date or add pydantic validator.
/api/categories DELETE blocks deletion of is_default — but if a user later renames a default sub, it stays is_default=True and undeletable. Consider only locking parents.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (core flows verified; Category sidebar select left unverified due to selector ambiguity)

test_credentials: N/A - single demo user, no auth
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create+cleanup TEST_HierAcct + 2 TEST_HIER_ records and a TEST_CascadeAcct. All cleaned in teardown. Frontend left one extra expense record (₹77 Food & Drinks on May 14, 2026) in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend hierarchy fully tested: GET /api/categories returns 93 (11 parents + 82 subs); type/parent_id filters work; /api/records?parent_category_id rolls children; /api/analytics/expenses-structure?group_by=parent buckets correctly; /api/analytics/report returns children[] under each parent row. Frontend AddRecord uses data-testid 'parent-pick-<kebab-name-with-&-preserved>' and 'sub-pick-<uuid>'. Records sidebar Category filter combobox order is [Sort, Account, Category, RecordType] when picking by index.
rca of the issue: No new bugs found. Only minor enhancements / nits listed under action_items and critical_code_review_comments.
